title: Measuring AI "Slop" in Text
abstract: arXiv:2509.19163v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI "slop" is an increasingly popular term used to describe low-quality AI-generated text, but there is currently no agreed upon definition of this term nor a means to measure its occurrence. In this work, we develop a taxonomy of "slop" through interviews with experts in NLP, writing, and philosophy, and propose a set of interpretable dimensions for its assessment in text. Through span-level annotation, we find that binary "slop" judgments are (somewhat) subjective, but such determinations nonetheless correlate with latent dimensions such as coherence and relevance. Our framework can be used to examine AI-generated text in both detection and binary preference tasks, potentially offering new insights into the linguistic and stylistic factors that contribute to quality judgments. We highlight that fully automated and scalable methods remain an open challenge.

translated_title: 度量文本中的AI“垃圾内容”
translated_abstract: AI“垃圾内容”是一个日益流行的术语，用于描述低质量的AI生成文本，但目前对这一术语尚无公认的定义，也没有衡量其出现的方法。在本研究中，我们通过对自然语言处理、写作和哲学领域专家的访谈，构建了“垃圾内容”的分类体系，并提出了一套可解释的维度用于在文本中对其进行评估。通过片段级标注，我们发现二元式的“垃圾内容”判断具有一定的主观性，但这种判断仍然与连贯性和相关性等潜在维度相关。我们的框架可用于在检测任务和二元偏好任务中考察AI生成的文本，有望为影响质量判断的语言与风格因素提供新的见解。我们同时指出，完全自动化且可扩展的度量方法仍然是一个悬而未决的挑战。
tldr: 本研究通过对NLP、写作和哲学领域专家的访谈，构建了AI“垃圾内容”的分类体系和可解释的评估维度，发现其二元判断虽带有主观性但与连贯性、相关性等潜在维度相关，为AI生成文本的质量评估提供了框架。
en_tdlr: This work builds a taxonomy of AI "slop" through expert interviews and proposes interpretable assessment dimensions, showing that binary slop judgments are somewhat subjective yet correlate with latent dimensions like coherence and relevance, providing a framework for evaluating AI-generated text quality.
